facts.fact: NIRA representatives interviewed for a study conducted between May and August 2024 said death registration requires completion of Form 12 and entry into the Mobile Vital Registration System (MVRS), the declarant of a community death presenting in person at the parish or sub-county offices to start the process; the study does not say at which office the entry is made.
The study, conducted between May and August 2024, names NIRA, established under the Registration of Persons Act, as the civil registration authority whose officers register deaths in the MVRS.

systems.tiers: not stated; declarants of community deaths present at parish or sub-county offices

systems.system: electronic Community Health Information System (eCHIS) community death notification workflow
systems.tiers: Village Health Teams and Community Health Extension Workers; about 11,099 VHTs and 160 CHEWs in 17 districts; synchronises with DHIS2, not with MVRS

systems.system: SMS death reporting platform, short code 6767
systems.tiers: Village Health Teams during the COVID-19 response; discontinued when project funding ended

systems.system: paper HMIS death reporting forms keyed into DHIS2
systems.tiers: Village Health Teams report quarterly on paper to health facilities

note: For the parent: the body is a truncated excerpt. It states that deaths in health facility systems and those registered through MVRS were not routinely reconciled, and that health and civil registration systems run in parallel.
